title: Ridgeline Door Series Booking Deposit and Card Payment Schedule
content:
Booking deposit figures for Entry & Patio Door Contracts are set per door series. A contract paid by cash, check or card uses the deposit percentage and the deposit minimum; a contract whose payment method is Ridgeline financing uses the financed deposit percentage, to which no minimum applies.

| Door series | Deposit percentage (cash, check or card) | Deposit minimum (cash, check or card) | Financed deposit percentage (Ridgeline financing, no minimum) | Deposit window after signing | Largest single card payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 35% | $600.00 | 0% | 5 calendar days | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 35% | $700.00 | 0% | 5 calendar days | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 40% | $800.00 | 10% | 5 calendar days | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 40% | $900.00 | 10% | 5 calendar days | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 50% | $1200.00 | 15% | 5 calendar days | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 50% | $1500.00 | 20% | 5 calendar days | $15000.00 |

## Definitions

- **Deposit percentage**: the booking deposit as a share of the contract price, for contracts paid by cash, check or card.
- **Deposit minimum**: the floor of the booking deposit for contracts paid by cash, check or card.
- **Financed deposit percentage**: the booking deposit as a share of the contract price when the payment method is Ridgeline financing; no floor applies. A financed deposit percentage of 0% means no booking deposit is taken on a financed contract of that series.
- **Deposit window**: the number of calendar days after the contract signing date within which the booking deposit is due.
- **Largest single card payment**: the largest single card payment accepted toward the contract, in US dollars.

## Notes on the schedule

- The Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door and the Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door both carry a financed deposit percentage of 0%; the four other series carry 10%, 15% or 20% as shown.
- The deposit window is 5 calendar days and the single card payment limit is $15000.00 in every series.
- Hypothetical: a payment of $16000.00 toward a door contract cannot be taken as one card payment in any series, because it exceeds $15000.00.
